text:
[Act: limitation
 Chapter: First Division · Part IX · Suits Relating to Miscellaneous Matters
 Section: 111::Thirty years.
]


By or on behalf of any local authority for possession of any public street or road or any part thereof from which it has been dispossessed or of which it has discontinued the possession.
Period of limitationThirty years.
Time from which period begins to runThe date of the dispossession or discontinuance.
